description: Aloe pretoriensis, is a species of Aloe found discontinuously in northern South Africa, eastern Zimbabwe and eastern Eswatini. It occurs in rocky grassland at generally higher altitudes. The pointy flowers are carried on elongated racemes on a decidedly tall and branched peduncle.
